newsitem.title: FINLAND: CASTRUM SAYS ITS REAL ESTATE VALUED AT FIM 487 MLN.
newsitem.headline: CASTRUM SAYS ITS REAL ESTATE VALUED AT FIM 487 MLN.

text.p: Finnish real estate investment company Castrum Oy said on Friday that its real estate assets have been valued at 487 million markka.
"Castrum has ordered new assessments of its real estate assets which are valued at 487 million markka," Castrum said in a statement.
The book value of Castrum's real estate in its 1995 financial statement was 542 million markka, it said.
But during 1996 there have been no changes in the real estate portfolio, it added.
Castrum has commissioned assessments of its real estate assets yearly.
